title.es: Ponerse al día después de un cambio

es: Compartir un cambio con consecuencia presente.
Aportar dos detalles pasados con fechas o métodos verificables.
Formular y responder dos preguntas de seguimiento pertinentes.

teaching.en: My role has changed, so I manage a larger team now.
teaching.es: Mi puesto ha cambiado, así que ahora dirijo un equipo mayor.
teaching.explanationEs: El cambio en present perfect abre el reencuentro con un efecto actual.

segments.en: I manage a larger team now.
segments.es: que ahora dirijo un equipo mayor.

teaching.audioText: My role has changed, so I manage a larger team now.

teaching.en: One detail is that I joined the department last September.
teaching.es: Un detalle es que me incorporé al departamento en septiembre pasado.
teaching.explanationEs: Past simple aporta un momento terminado que concreta la actualización.

segments.es: incorporé al departamento en septiembre pasado.

teaching.audioText: One detail is that I joined the department last September.

teaching.en: A colleague recommended the opportunity to me.
teaching.es: Un colega me recomendó la oportunidad.
teaching.explanationEs: El detalle explica cómo apareció la oportunidad.
teaching.audioText: A colleague recommended the opportunity to me.

teaching.en: Ask two follow-up questions: one about when and one about how.
teaching.es: Haz dos preguntas: una sobre cuándo y otra sobre cómo.
teaching.explanationEs: Las dos preguntas recuperan fecha y método sin cambiar el tema.

segments.en: about when and one about how.

teaching.audioText: Ask two follow-up questions: one about when and one about how.

teaching.en: Answer each question with a specific detail, not only yes or no.
teaching.es: Responde cada pregunta con un detalle específico, no solo sí o no.
teaching.explanationEs: Una respuesta informativa mantiene el reencuentro y verifica la noticia.

segments.en: Answer each question with a specific
segments.es: Responde cada pregunta con un detalle

segments.en: detail, not only yes or no.
segments.es: específico, no solo sí o no.

teaching.audioText: Answer each question with a specific detail, not only yes or no.

teaching.en: Mara: I have joined a community kitchen, so I cook for families now. I started on 8 February after a neighbour recommended the opportunity. We have already served fifty meals, and we are planning weekend sessions. Leo: When did you start? How did you hear about it? Mara: On 8 February; my neighbour told me.
teaching.es: Mara se unió a una cocina comunitaria y ahora cocina para familias. Empezó el 8 de febrero por recomendación de una vecina. Ya sirvieron cincuenta comidas y planean sesiones de fin de semana. Leo pregunta cuándo empezó y cómo conoció la oportunidad; Mara responde.
teaching.explanationEs: El modelo integra cambio actual, experiencia, detalles pasados, progreso y seguimiento.

prompt.es: Elige la apertura que comparte un cambio relevante ahora.

choices.text: I changed jobs in 2018 and forgot the date.
I have started a new role, so I work with a larger team now.
I may look for a role next year.

feedback.es: Have started introduce el cambio y el equipo mayor muestra su efecto actual.

hint.es: Busca un cambio reciente unido a una situación presente.

prompt.es: Ordena la pregunta que solicita un detalle de fecha.

answer.text: When did you begin the new course?

feedback.es: When did you begin pide el momento concreto del cambio.

hint.es: Coloca did antes del sujeto y usa begin en forma base.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada pregunta con el detalle de seguimiento.

pairs: How did you find the position?

feedback.es: How pide el proceso y what has changed explora el efecto presente.

hint.es: Distingue el camino pasado de la situación que continúa.

pairs: How did you find the position?

prompt.es: Escribe el cambio de Hana y una pregunta de seguimiento.

answer.text: Hana has completed a design course, so she works in advertising now. When did she finish it?
accepted: Hana has completed a design course, so she works in advertising now. When did she finish it?
Hana now works in advertising because she has completed a design course. When did the course end?

feedback.es: Las variantes conectan cambio, resultado actual y pregunta de fecha.

origin.text: Hana terminó curso de diseño y ahora trabaja en publicidad. Pregunta: cuándo terminó.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cómo consiguió Malik su nuevo trabajo.

feedback.es: Recommended him in February explica el método y aporta el detalle fechado.

origin.audio: Malik has found a new job at a hotel. A former teacher recommended him in February.

prompt.es: Une cada parte del reencuentro con su función.

pairs: What do you like about it?

feedback.es: El intercambio separa noticia, momento concreto y pregunta relacionada.

pairs: What do you like about it?

prompt.es: Elige la respuesta que une experiencia y hecho fechado.

choices.text: I have taught online, and I led my first virtual class last October.
I have taught online, and I have led my first class last October.
I have taught online, and I have led classes since last October.

feedback.es: Have taught resume la experiencia y led last October aporta el episodio concreto.

prompt.es: Escucha y selecciona el resultado que sigue vigente.

choices.text: She will take the exam next June
She can apply for hospital jobs now

feedback.es: Can apply now es el efecto presente de haber completado el curso.

origin.audio: Eva has completed her nursing course. She passed the final exam on 20 June, and she can apply for hospital jobs now.

prompt.es: Redacta dos preguntas para ampliar la actualización de Omar.

answer.text: When did you open the bakery? How did your aunt help you learn?
accepted: When did you open the bakery? How did your aunt help you learn?
What date did the bakery open? How did you learn from your aunt?

feedback.es: Las preguntas solicitan fecha y método sin repetir la información dada.

origin.text: Omar ha abierto una panadería; abrió el local en marzo y aprendió con su tía.

prompt.es: Escribe 70–100 palabras para el reencuentro en el estudio musical.

answer.text: Jo: I have opened a music studio, so I can offer evening lessons now. I opened it on 12 January, and a local school donated the equipment. We are preparing to record a community choir next. I have also invited three local musicians to help with the first recording next month. Lina: When did the studio open? How did you get the equipment? Jo: It opened on 12 January, and the school gave it to us.
accepted: Jo: I have opened a music studio, so I can offer evening lessons now. I opened it on 12 January, and a local school donated the equipment. We are preparing to record a community choir next. I have also invited three local musicians to help with the first recording next month. Lina: When did the studio open? How did you get the equipment? Jo: It opened on 12 January, and the school gave it to us.

Jo: I have started a music studio and now teach evening classes there. The studio opened on 12 January after a local school donated its equipment. Our next project is recording a community choir. I have also invited three local musicians to help with the first recording next month. Lina: What date did you open? How did you obtain the instruments? Jo: On 12 January; the school gave them to us.

feedback.es: El diálogo integra cambio, efecto, dos detalles, próximo paso y dos preguntas respondidas.

origin.text: Lina no ve a Jo desde hace un año. Jo abrió estudio musical; ahora ofrece clases nocturnas. Abrió 12 enero; equipos donados por escuela. Próximo: grabar coro con tres músicos locales el mes próximo. Lina pregunta fecha y método; Jo responde.

prompt.es: Clasifica los datos del reencuentro de dos antiguas compañeras.

pairs: I have become a team leader.

feedback.es: La recuperación distingue noticia, fecha y pregunta relacionada.

pairs: I have become a team leader.

prompt.es: Ordena dos preguntas sobre la fecha y el método del cambio.

answer.text: When did the change happen? How did you find the opportunity?

feedback.es: When recupera la fecha y how solicita el método de la oportunidad.

prompt.es: Redacta 70–100 palabras para el reencuentro del club ciclista.

answer.text: Iris: I have created a cycling club, so thirty members train together every week now. We held our first ride on 4 May, and a local shop provided the helmets. The club has also completed a safety workshop for all its new riders. Next, we are planning a charity route. Noah: When was your first ride? How did you get the helmets? Iris: It was on 4 May, and the shop supplied them.
accepted: Iris: I have created a cycling club, so thirty members train together every week now. We held our first ride on 4 May, and a local shop provided the helmets. The club has also completed a safety workshop for all its new riders. Next, we are planning a charity route. Noah: When was your first ride? How did you get the helmets? Iris: It was on 4 May, and the shop supplied them.

Iris: I have started a cycling club that now has thirty weekly riders. Our first group ride took place on 4 May, and a local shop gave us the helmets. The club has also completed a safety workshop for all its new riders. We will organise a charity route next. Noah: What date was the first ride? How did the shop help? Iris: On 4 May; it supplied the helmets.

feedback.es: La recuperación demuestra las cinco funciones en un club y cronología nuevos.

origin.text: Noah vuelve a ver a Iris. Iris creó club ciclista; ahora 30 miembros entrenan cada semana. Primera salida: 4 mayo. Tienda local dio cascos. Ya completaron taller de seguridad. Próximo: ruta benéfica. Noah pregunta fecha y método; Iris responde.
